## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type

- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] docs
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test / ci
- [ ] breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] `bash tests/run.sh` passes
- [ ] `bash scripts/check-version-sync.sh` passes
- [ ] `bash -n` passes for changed scripts
- [ ] Config/schema changed together (if applicable)
- [ ] `references/` updated (if user-facing behavior changed)

## Release note

One or two lines that can be used in CHANGELOG.
